evals.prompt: I'm on omp 18.14.0. For this repository only, set the default model role to openai/gpt-5.2. The attached files are copies of my global config and the repo's project config. Update a copy of the project config in your output sandbox only, preserve all existing project settings, and explain why `omp config set` is or is not the right command for a project-only setting. Do not touch the real home directory or run a command that writes to it.
evals.expected_output: An updated project config fixture with only the project model role changed, plus a concise explanation of scope, precedence, and when the active model will change.
expectations: The project config copy contains modelRoles.default set to openai/gpt-5.2 and preserves its existing tools.approvalMode and memory settings.
The global config fixture is left unchanged.
The response explains that omp config set writes the global config and that a project-only override belongs in the project's .omp/config.yml.
The response explains that changing a default role does not necessarily switch the model in an already-running session.

evals.prompt: Add a remote Notion MCP server to the attached project's .omp/mcp.json. Use Streamable HTTP and the NOTION_TOKEN environment variable; never put a real token in the file. Work on a copy under your output sandbox only, preserve the existing filesystem server, and tell me how to reload and verify the new server in OMP.
evals.expected_output: Valid updated MCP JSON with the existing server preserved, a remote HTTP server using an environment-backed Authorization value, and OMP-specific verification steps.
expectations: The output JSON parses and keeps the existing filesystem server configuration.
The Notion server uses type http with the official Notion MCP URL and an Authorization header that references NOTION_TOKEN without a hard-coded token.
The response gives OMP verification steps including /mcp reload and /mcp list or /mcp test.

evals.prompt: Create a reusable release checklist for OMP in the attached scratch project. I want the model to select the full procedure when the task is about preparing a software release, but I don't want it injected as permanent repository context on every unrelated task. Create the right OMP resource at the right project path with useful skill frontmatter and a concise checklist. Work only in a copy under your output sandbox and explain how I can invoke or verify it.
evals.expected_output: A project-scoped OMP skill at .omp/skills/release-check/SKILL.md, with routing metadata and actionable release validation steps, plus an explanation of how OMP discovers and invokes it.
expectations: The created file is .omp/skills/release-check/SKILL.md in the output sandbox.
The skill has valid frontmatter with explicit name and a description that routes release-preparation tasks.
The body contains a concrete release checklist and does not create a permanent AGENTS.md or RULES.md instruction.
The response explains OMP skill discovery and gives a manual invocation or verification route.
